chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Playing Switzerland for big pay
summary: Based in Paris he guested with Bill Coleman in Switzerland, earning hundreds of dollars a night.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well you were interested in it apart from anything else. But what was the work? What were the work opportunities like?
What sort of things were you doing?
I was playing, I was based in Paris, but I was playing everywhere. I would go

to Switzerland to play with Bill Coleman's band as guest artist. You see when I wasn't playing with my band I played all over Switzerland and made a lot of money. Sometimes they paid me three or four hundred dollars for one night. And I didn't believe them. Me and Bishop would say, gee, they must have made a mistake. They'd pay it to us in Francs and we'd change the Francs the next day and they'd give us three or four hundred dollars in dollars. And we were sure they'd made a mistake but there was just a lot of money.
And in LUZERNE, around we'd play for one big ball. And we were known as the great American artists. Me from Count Basie, Bish from Earl Hines. And they paid us about seven hundred dollars, I think.
Well I suppose part of it was that you sort of got in on it early.
That was another thing wasn't it? That was before they started to tour bands and .....
